hunks.sol: *If I stay at the Jin Family of Taiyuan, there’s a limit to how far I can grow.*

hunks.sol: The incident with the Roaring Fury Swordsman had taught me that. No matter what I obtained, without the strength to protect it, I would only end up at someone else’s mercy.

hunks.baseline: I needed a turning point if I wanted to become stronger than I was now, and Heaven’s Gate Temple was a place where both safety and opportunity were guaranteed.
hunks.sol: I needed a turning point if I wanted to become stronger, and Heaven’s Gate Temple offered both safety and opportunity.

hunks.baseline: *Unless I’m really the Fire King’s Disciple, this is definitely the best option available to me right now.*
